## Findings
- claim-1: For \(p_a(t)=[z^t]\prod_{k=1}^a(1-z^k)^{-1}\), with \(p_a(t)=0\) for \(t<0\), \[ \#\{\rho\subseteq b^a:|\rho|=N\} =\sum_{S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,a\}}(-1)^{|S|} p_a\!\left(N-|S|b-\sum_{s\in S}s\right). \]
- claim-2: Complementation \(\rho^\vee=(b-\rho_a,\ldots,b-\rho_1)\) gives \[ \#\{\rho\subseteq b^a:|\rho|=N\} =\#\{\rho\subseteq b^a:|\rho|=ab-N\}. \]
- claim-3: Conditional on the accepted graded integral basis \(Q=\bigoplus_{\rho\subseteq b^a}\mathbb Z e_\rho\), \(\deg e_\rho=ij+|\rho|\), \[ \operatorname{rank}Q_{ij+N} =\sum_{S\subseteq[a]}(-1)^{|S|} p_a\!\left(N-|S|b-\sum_{s\in S}s\right), \] and \(Q_{ij+N}\) is free abelian, vanishing unless \(0\le N\le ab\).
## Strategy
Let \(R_{a,b}(z)=\sum_{\rho\subseteq b^a}z^{|\rho|}\). The standard rectangle recurrence gives
\[
R_{a,b}(z)=\prod_{k=1}^a\frac{1-z^{b+k}}{1-z^k}.
\]
Expanding its numerator,
\[
\prod_{k=1}^a(1-z^{b+k})
=\sum_{S\subseteq[a]}(-1)^{|S|}
 z^{|S|b+\sum_{s\in S}s}.
\]
Thus, with \(p_a(t)=0\) for \(t<0\),
\[
[z^N]R_{a,b}(z)
=\sum_{S\subseteq[a]}(-1)^{|S|}
p_a\!\left(N-|S|b-\sum_{s\in S}s\right).
\]
This proves the requested coefficient formula.

The map
\[
\rho=(\rho_1,\ldots,\rho_a)\longmapsto
\rho^\vee=(b-\rho_a,\ldots,b-\rho_1)
\]
is an involution of partitions in \(b^a\), with
\[
|\rho^\vee|=ab-|\rho|.
\]
Hence the coefficients satisfy \(R_{a,b}(N)=R_{a,b}(ab-N)\).

Conditional on the accepted integral graded basis
\[
Q=\bigoplus_{\rho\subseteq b^a}\mathbb Z e_\rho,\qquad
\deg e_\rho=ij+|\rho|,
\]
one obtains
\[
\operatorname{rank}Q_{ij+N}
=\sum_{S\subseteq[a]}(-1)^{|S|}
p_a\!\left(N-|S|b-\sum_{s\in S}s\right),
\]
and
\[
\operatorname{rank}Q_{ij+N}
=\operatorname{rank}Q_{ij+ab-N}.
\]
Moreover \(Q_{ij+N}\) is free abelian and vanishes unless \(0\le N\le ab\).

The requested target is established; the assertions about \(Q\) retain the stated accepted-basis dependency.

## Gaps
The graded-basis statement for \(Q\) is used as accepted project context and is not reproved here.
